title: Internal board reads and writes respect canonical S3 records and catalog freshness
description:
As a user, I want durable internal work to have a clear saved state so I can trust what the bot and board report.

Proposed acceptance behavior for future implementation; not executable proof or a delivery claim.

```gherkin
Feature: Durable cloud internal board records
  Scenario: Reopen a confirmed saved item
    Given an internal board change has been confirmed durably saved
    When an authorized user reopens that item in a later session
    Then the canonical saved issue content is available
  Scenario: Catalog results lag a saved change
    Given an internal board change is saved but its catalog entry is not yet current
    When the board reports the result of that change
    Then it does not present conflicting index content as canonical issue text
    And it presents the saved or pending state according to the reviewed consistency contract
  Scenario: A save cannot be confirmed
    Given a board update cannot be confirmed durably saved
    When the bot reports the update outcome
    Then it does not report the issue update as successfully saved
```

Design/acceptance questions before implementation: Specify acknowledged durability, revision/conflict behavior, catalog lag, retries, reconciliation and rebuild acceptance tests. Requested storage: canonical files/text on S3 and DynamoDB card-catalog indexes. Validate the Kanbus/Virtuus backend before integration; do not presume an existing adapter, schema, transaction scheme or deployed service.
right_now_summary: The team is defining durability and consistency rules before integrating S3 and DynamoDB.
